description: This file contains extension methods for configuring endpoint options in Orleans silos. It provides overloaded methods to set up silo endpoints with different parameter options like IP address, hostname, ports, address family, and whether to listen on all IP addresses.

classes.name: EndpointOptionsExtensions
classes.description: A static class containing extension methods for configuring endpoint options for Orleans silos.

methods.name: ConfigureEndpoints
methods.description: Configures the silo endpoints using an advertised IP address and ports, with optional listening on all host IPs.

methods.name: ConfigureEndpoints
methods.description: Configures the silo endpoints using a hostname, ports, address family, and optional listening on all host IPs.

methods.name: ConfigureEndpoints
methods.description: Configures the silo endpoints using only ports, address family, and optional listening on all host IPs, resolving IP from hostname.
